description: Type Filestore's per-region storage capacity quota on instance create. It surfaced as the generic throttling-category TooManyRequests (HTTP 429), so callers retried a hard capacity limit for minutes and could not tell it apart from rate limiting. Observed live 2026-09-29: createProjectsLocationsInstances with tier ZONAL -> 429 "Quota limit 'EnterpriseStorageGibPerRegion' has been exceeded. Limit: 0 in region us-central1."

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The project's per-region Filestore storage quota for the requested tier is exhausted (HTTP 429: "Quota limit '<Tier>StorageGibPerRegion' has been exceeded. Limit: N in region R."). A capacity limit, not rate limiting — deliberately carries no httpError so it is not classified as throttling and retried; it clears only when quota is raised or storage is freed.
